policy: Fresh holdout. Reference labels were fixed from publications distinct from engine-side evidence snapshots before engine execution. No production rule may be changed during scoring.

cases.reference_basis: 2023 MASCC/ESMO evidence review found conflicting evidence and made no recommendation for ingested ginger.
2023 Cochrane review found moderate-certainty evidence that cranberry products reduce symptomatic culture-verified UTIs overall and in several relevant groups.
2024 guideline-focused systematic screening reported peppermint oil as strongly recommended for IBS, particularly pain and flatulence.
Systematic review concluded the efficacy literature for Rhodiola in physical and mental fatigue is contradictory.

2026 network meta-analysis supports therapeutic potential of plant extracts including hawthorn as adjunctive therapy but explicitly calls for cautious interpretation because of limited studies and scarce direct comparative evidence.
